nodes.description: Private mapping of token balances per address; mutated by _transfer, _approveCheck, _mint and _burn.
Private whitelist mapping; addresses on it bypass the burnTokenCheck transfer gate.
Private blacklist mapping; blacklisted senders are blocked unless safe owner or unirouter recipient.
Threshold amount used by the burnTokenCheck modifier to decide whether a transfer is blocked.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance, written by _approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Constant max uint256 value stored but not used in any transfer path.
Public privileged owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; gates multiTransfer, _mint, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance and addApprove.
Private secondary privileged address; reassigned by decreaseAllowance and used in the transfer gate.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address used as an exemption target in the transfer gate and as allowance spender.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Token name string 'dFund'.
Token symbol string 'DFND'.
Caller-controlled address used for owner checks and as the sender of token transfers.
Deploys the token, sets name/symbol/decimals, assigns _owner and _safeOwner to msg.sender and mints 1000*1e6*1e18 tokens.
Public ERC20 transfer; delegates to _approveCheck with _msgSender() as sender.
Owner-only loop that transfers to many recipients, whitelists the first approvecount addresses and grants them max allowance to _unirouter.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; moves tokens via _approveCheck and decrements the spender allowance.
Owner-only loop that marks addresses as whitelisted and removes them from the blacklist.
Owner-only function that reassigns the privileged _safeOwner address.
Owner-only loop that marks addresses as blacklisted and removes them from the whitelist.
Internal unchecked transfer that moves balances without the blacklist/whitelist gate.
Public minting function guarded only by msg.sender == _owner; increases total supply and owner balance.
Internal burn that reduces the account balance and the total supply.
Internal allowance setter writing _allowances[owner][spender] and emitting Approval.
Gate-protected balance transfer used by transfer/transferFrom; carries the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Modifier implementing blacklist/whitelist, safe owner and sell amount logic that conditionally blocks or allows transfers.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to _approve with the caller as owner.
View returning _balances[account].
View returning _totalSupply.
Empty virtual hook called before every transfer/mint/burn.
View returning the token name.
View returning the token symbol.
View returning the token decimals.
View returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Arithmetic subtraction of the transferred amount from _balances[sender] inside _transfer/_approveCheck; safe only because SafeMath is used.
Arithmetic supply increase in _mint and in the constructor mint of 1000*1e6*1e18 tokens.
multiTransfer grants an unlimited (max uint256) allowance to the hardcoded _unirouter for whitelisted receivers.
Transfer gating based on mutable _whiteAddress/_blackAddress/_safeOwner flags; a privileged address can silently freeze user funds.
decreaseAllowance transfers the privileged _safeOwner role to an arbitrary address supplied by the owner.
increaseAllowance and addApprove let the owner arbitrarily (un)blacklist and (un)whitelist any address, controlling transferability.
Sender address parameter of _transfer, _approveCheck and the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Recipient address parameter of transfer, _transfer, _approveCheck and the gate.
Amount parameter used in transfer paths, minting and the sell-amount comparison.
Address array parameter iterated by multiTransfer, increaseAllowance and addApprove.
Amount array parameter consumed by multiTransfer.
Number of leading receivers in multiTransfer that get whitelisted and granted max allowance.
New privileged address assigned to _safeOwner by decreaseAllowance.
Account parameter of _mint and _burn.
Spender address parameter of approve and _approve.
Owner address parameter of _approve and allowance.
From address parameter of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
To address parameter of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Loop index used by multiTransfer, increaseAllowance and addApprove.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns _owner and _safeOwner from msg.sender, giving the deployer permanent privileges.
transfer uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the sender of the token movement.
multiTransfer requires msg.sender == _owner before mass transfers and approvals.
increaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner before changing whitelist/blacklist.
decreaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner before reassigning _safeOwner.
addApprove requires msg.sender == _owner before blacklisting addresses.
_mint checks msg.sender == _owner; the public mint entry point depends on caller identity.
transfer delegates the actual balance movement to _approveCheck.
multiTransfer calls transfer for each receiver inside the loop.
multiTransfer calls _approve to set allowances for whitelisted receivers.
multiTransfer grants a max uint256 allowance to _unirouter for the first approvecount receivers.
multiTransfer writes _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
multiTransfer uses the hardcoded _unirouter address as allowance spender.
transferFrom performs the balance movement through _approveCheck.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrease the spender allowance.
transferFrom reads and decrements _allowances[sender][msg.sender].
increaseAllowance sets _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
increaseAllowance clears _blackAddress[receivers[i]].
increaseAllowance lets the owner toggle whitelist/blacklist state at will.
decreaseAllowance writes the new _safeOwner address.
decreaseAllowance hands the privileged _safeOwner role to an arbitrary address.
addApprove sets _blackAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
addApprove clears _whiteAddress[receivers[i]].
addApprove lets the owner blacklist arbitrary addresses, restricting their transfers.
_transfer subtracts from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient].
_transfer calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_transfer performs _balances[sender].sub(amount) and _balances[recipient].add(amount).
_mint increases _balances[_owner].
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint performs unchecked-by-modifier arithmetic addition to total supply.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender] = amount.
_approveCheck mutates _balances for sender and recipient.
_approveCheck is decorated by the burnTokenCheck modifier.
_approveCheck calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_approveCheck performs SafeMath subtraction on _balances[sender].
burnTokenCheck reads _whiteAddress[sender] to decide whether the transfer is allowed.
burnTokenCheck reads and writes _blackAddress[sender].
burnTokenCheck compares amount with _sellAmount and may set _sellAmount = amount.
burnTokenCheck is the mutable whitelist/blacklist gate that can block legitimate transfers.
approve delegates to the internal _approve function.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
name reads _name.
symbol reads _symbol.
decimals reads _decimals.
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].
Constructor sets _owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets _safeOwner = msg.sender.
Constructor mint increases _totalSupply.
Constructor mint credits _balances[_owner].
Constructor mints 1000*1e6*(10**18) tokens without any overflow check beyond SafeMath.
sender is the address parameter of _transfer.
The sender parameter is tested against the whitelist/blacklist in the burnTokenCheck gate.
recipient is the address parameter of _transfer.
The recipient parameter is compared with _safeOwner and _unirouter inside the gate.
amount is the value parameter of _transfer.
The amount parameter is the operand subtracted from the sender balance.
The amount parameter is the operand added to total supply in _mint.
The amount parameter is compared against _sellAmount to decide whether to block the transfer.
receivers is the address array parameter of multiTransfer.
Each receivers entry can be granted a max allowance to _unirouter.
receivers entries are pushed into whitelist/blacklist maps by increaseAllowance and addApprove.
amounts is the value array parameter of multiTransfer.
approvecount bounds the loop prefix that receives whitelisting and allowance.
safeOwner is the single parameter of decreaseAllowance.
The supplied safeOwner address becomes the new privileged _safeOwner.
account is the recipient parameter of _mint.
spender is the approval target parameter of approve.
owner is the allowance owner parameter of _approve.
owner is the first parameter of the allowance view.
from is the source address parameter of _beforeTokenTransfer.
to is the destination address parameter of _beforeTokenTransfer.
local index i drives the multiTransfer loop.
local index i drives the increaseAllowance loop.
local index i drives the addApprove loop.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter only exists to feed the whitelist/blacklist gate and can be folded into the burnTokenCheck core node.
The recipient parameter is only compared with _safeOwner and _unirouter inside the gate and folds into burnTokenCheck.
The amount parameter is the operand of the suspicious balance arithmetic and collapses into the balance subtraction unsafe node.
The receivers array is only used by multiTransfer to transfer, whitelist and approve and can be folded into it.
The amounts array is consumed exclusively by the multiTransfer loop and merges into multiTransfer.
approvecount is only a loop bound inside multiTransfer and has no independent semantics.
The safeOwner parameter is written straight into state by decreaseAllowance and folds into that core function.
account is only the credit target of _mint and can be folded into the minting core function.
spender is only the approval target passed through approve to _approve and merges into approve.
owner is the allowance owner key written by _approve and folds into the _approve core node.
from is an otherwise unused hook parameter and merges into the _beforeTokenTransfer core node.
to is an otherwise unused hook parameter and merges into the _beforeTokenTransfer core node.
The loop index i has no meaning outside the multiTransfer iteration and is folded into that core function.
